topics.snippet: LAGER: sticky house+search+chips. Single house: −/＋ draft dock then save. All houses: optional tile grid. stock_adjust {houseId,productQuery,dir:IN|OUT,qty}. stock_set {houseId,productQuery,qty} absolute. want_bought {houseId,productQuery} adds to Friday list. Shift stock check Kalyvia h1 via ☑️.
LISTE: house+Friday+quick-add. shop_add/shop_remove. Store mode: ✓/∅/€ then confirmBatch. Import via Liste einlesen (OCR). Prefer activeHouse + shopFriday from context.

PLAN: day/week/matrix. Day overrides: schedule_add|update|cancel (PIN). Template admin: schedule_template_add|update day 0=Mon…6=Sun. Blocks: morning|afternoon|evening. Match activityQuery to context activities.
SCHICHT: shift_note {text,houseId?} appends to own shift diary on Buch. Stock check credit is separate (shift stock check UI).
NAV: open_tab {tab:home|gallery|schedule|stock|shop|book} after confirm switches UI only (no data mutate).
MOMENTE: private feed, share FAB, Drive media when configured. Zo-Ai cannot post/delete photos — guide user to Share.
CHILD: today/week/events/games/gallery only. Zo-Ai read-only — never paidia-action.
ADMIN: Admin center, permanent template, contacts, security. Template actions admin-only. Never reveal PINs.
